# Onur Yunisli

> Graphic and motion designer in Baku, Azerbaijan (GMT+4), working worldwide. AI commercials and AI ad films, motion design, logo animation, 3D product animation, packaging and brand identity — for brands directly and white-label for agencies. Works with Element, a creative and spatial design studio in Baku.

Contact: onuryunisli@gmail.com

## Services

- [AI commercials](https://onuryunisli.com/services/ai-commercials/): AI commercials and ad films directed shot by shot — script, storyboard, generation, edit, sound and grade. For brands and agencies in the US, UK, UAE and Europe.
- [AI product videos](https://onuryunisli.com/services/ai-product-videos/): AI product videos and e-commerce ads: your real product in new scenes, formats and hooks — generated with Seedance, Veo and Kling, finished with 3D and compositing.
- [Social media content](https://onuryunisli.com/services/social-media-content/): Social media video content for brands: motion graphics, 3D loops and AI clips for Reels, TikTok, Shorts and LinkedIn — campaign series and monthly content in every format.
- [Motion design](https://onuryunisli.com/services/motion-design/): Motion design for brands and agencies: brand motion systems, social media animation, explainer videos and campaign graphics. Eight years of client work, from Baku.
- [Logo animation](https://onuryunisli.com/services/logo-animation/): Logo animation for brands and agencies: 2D and 3D animated logos, intros, outros and motion kits, delivered in every format. Fixed quote within one working day.
- [Explainer videos](https://onuryunisli.com/services/explainer-videos/): Explainer videos that make a product, service or process clear in about a minute: script, storyboard, 2D and 3D animation, voice-over and sound.
- [3D product animation](https://onuryunisli.com/services/3d-product-animation/): 3D product animation and photoreal CGI for packaging, beverages, cosmetics and launches — rendered and animated in Cinema 4D and Redshift.
- [Packaging design](https://onuryunisli.com/services/packaging-design/): Packaging and label design for beverages, food and supplements, shown in photoreal 3D before printing — SIRAB, Badamlı, Dinamit, JUIZ, ALIVE and LIVGRT.
- [Brand identity](https://onuryunisli.com/services/brand-identity/): Brand identity design for companies, products and events: logo, typography, colour, guidelines, packaging and motion. Work for AzerGold, AZVIRT, Istanbul 2027 and more.
- [White-label for agencies](https://onuryunisli.com/services/white-label/): Overflow motion design, 3D, logo animation and AI video production for agencies in the US, UK, UAE and Europe — under your name, in your files, with an NDA.
- [AI tools](https://onuryunisli.com/ai-tools/): The AI video and image tools behind my commercials and product films — Higgsfield, Seedance 2.0, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0 and Nano Banana Pro — what each is best at, and how they fit with motion and 3D.
- [Beverage & mineral water](https://onuryunisli.com/industries/beverages/): Packaging, 3D product animation, campaign films and social motion for mineral water, soft drink, energy drink and coffee brands — SIRAB, Badamlı, Dinamit, JUIZ and more.
- [Beauty, wellness & supplements](https://onuryunisli.com/industries/beauty-wellness/): 3D product animation, packaging and launch content for collagen, hydration and wellness brands — premium, clean and trustworthy on screen.
- [Energy, mining & corporate](https://onuryunisli.com/industries/energy-corporate/): Identity, anniversary programmes, motion and award-winning exhibition stands for energy, mining, construction and corporate groups — TPAO, AzerGold, AZVIRT, BE GROUP.
- [Retail, food & hospitality](https://onuryunisli.com/industries/retail-hospitality/): Brand identity, teaser campaigns, packaging and motion for hotels, supermarkets, food producers and home retailers — Baku Resort & Spa, TAMStore, Lezzet Group.
- [Events, sports & public sector](https://onuryunisli.com/industries/events-sports/): Logos, event identities and motion for international games, forums, football clubs and cities — Istanbul 2027 European Games, Shusha Global Media Forum, Ankara.

## Writing

- [How much does an AI commercial cost in 2026?](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/how-much-does-an-ai-commercial-cost-in-2026/): What you actually pay for in an AI commercial — shots, product accuracy, versions and finishing — with 2026 industry benchmarks for traditional production.
- [AI vs traditional commercial production: what actually changes](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/ai-vs-traditional-commercial-production/): AI didn’t make directing obsolete — it moved where the work happens. Pre-production, the shoot, the product, post and versions compared.
- [Seedance, Veo or Kling? How I choose a model for each shot](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/seedance-veo-kling-choosing-a-model/): No single AI model wins every shot. How Seedance 2.0, Veo 3.1 and Kling 3.0 divide the work in a commercial — and how to choose.
- [How to keep a product consistent across AI shots](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/keep-product-consistent-ai-video/): Generated products drift — labels soften, caps change colour. A six-step method to keep your real product exact in every AI shot.
- [Refresh, don't redraw: designing a 10th anniversary identity](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/anniversary-brand-identity-what-to-change/): An anniversary mark is not a new logo. On AzerGold's tenth year we kept the equity and changed only what the milestone could honestly own.
- [A mineral water label that still reads from two metres](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/mineral-water-packaging-design/): Shelf is a distance problem before it is a taste problem. How the SIRAB redesign kept 75 years of recognition and still cleaned the label up.
- [Hospitality identity is an object problem](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/hospitality-brand-identity-design/): A hotel brand is met on keys, signage, linen and a bottle in the minibar — not on a screen. Designing the Baku Resort & Spa identity around that.
- [An exhibition stand is a brand read at forty metres](https://onuryunisli.com/posts/exhibition-stand-design-process/): For TPAO at the 31st Caspian Oil & Gas Exhibition — a stand is designed backwards, from the far sightline to the handshake.
